boundary_findings: Allocated empty copper product is not cable-waste treatment. Preserve0.18kWh,4e-10manual-WEEE facility units and0.34kg plastic treatment plus source freight per kg cable.
Plastic-conduit building-waste disposal includes deconstruction/sorting and is not the wire-plastic incineration market.
The native whole-cable service adds0.25tkm freight and0.648MJ waste heat absent from the source operator; use inspected component services instead.
Old Swiss rail operation lacks vehicle/track lifecycle and does not represent the source PF-diesel/electric market mix. Use complete already-reviewed Swiss services with unnormalized source shares.
scope_limits: Actual exact profiles only; preserve historical observations without creating an executable consequential route.
Parent repair requires an original source-provider quantity witness; no global substitution by target name.
Preserve allocated copper stock, actual building-waste functions, source credit signs and already-correct modern Swiss rail services.
Caller uncertainty/formulas/foreground ownership/separate physical emissions preserved; internal source-market uncertainty/formulas not reconstructed.
Reverse resources independently unchanged; no inverse inferred.
